text: Ẹni ò lè ṣe bí alábàárù ní Ọ̀yìngbó, kò lè ṣe bí Adégbòrò l'ọjà Ọba.
Bọ́rí bá pé nílè, a díre.
translation_en: It may take long; there's hope to rise again.

text: Ojú kì í pọ́n sí i, kò máa lá.
translation_en: No matter the level of suffering, there's better days ahead.

text: Bá mi nà ọmọ mi, kó dénú olómo.
translation_en: Be careful when people invite you to correct or discipline their loved ones; loyalty can easily shift back against you.

text: Ẹnu ti èékáná ńlépa kò roju, bí ó ti ń re ènìyàn bẹ́ẹ̀ lo ń re ara-ọ̀run.
translation_en: Persevere through hardships, because your adversary or problem is also wearing down.

text: Ilé la ti ǹ kọ́ ẹ̀ṣọ́ ròde.
translation_en: Good character and upbringing must be established within the family before displaying it to the world.

text: Ilé ọba tó jó, ẹwà ló bù sí.
translation_en: Make the best of any tragic or difficult situation; good can come out of adversity.

text: Bí àgbàda ò bá gbóná, àgbàdo ò lèè ta.
translation_en: Good things do not always come easy; hard work and tough times build success (no pain, no gain).

text: Ṣé dáadáa ni, mo wà pẹ̀lú àlàáfíà. Orúkọ mi ni Adé. Kí ni orúkọ ẹ?
translation_en: I am fine, I am doing well. My name is Ade. What is your name?

text: Orúkọ mi ni Tálà. Nibo lo ti wá?
translation_en: My name is Tala. Where do you come from?

text: Mo wá láti Èkó. Ọ̀rẹ́ mi ni mí. Ò dabo!
translation_en: I am from Lagos. It is nice to meet you. Goodbye!

text: Báwo ni ojú ọ̀jọ̀ ṣe rí lónìí?
Ògì àti àkàrà ni mo jẹ ní àárọ̀ yìí.
translation_en: I ate beans cake and pap this morning.
